{
  "score": 4,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "high",
      "line": 3583,
      "message": "The cycle dispatch-unit skip guard reads `.stage_statuses[\"$_safe_cyc_id\"] == \"complete\"` but cycles are never written to `stage_statuses` — the entire block including the DSRHYD-2 fail-closed artifact check (lines 3590-3629) is unreachable dead code, so completed cycles are always re-entered on resume and cycle-member artifact absence after rehydration is never caught.",
      "quote": "if $resume_mode && [[ -z \"$skip_until_stage\" ]]; then\n                        local _du_cyc_status\n                        # Sanitize cycle id to prevent jq injection via template-sourced values.\n                        local _safe_cyc_id=\"${_cyc_id//[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/}\"\n                        _du_cyc_status=\"$(get_state_field \"$state_file\" \\\n                            \".stage_statuses[\\\"$_safe_cyc_id\\\"]\" '' 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n                        if [[ \"$_du_cyc_status\" == \"complete\" ]]; then",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "high",
      "line": 2434,
      "message": "`_ZBUILD_FROM_STAGE_EMIT_START=true` sets `_is_resume=true`, which activates the DSCMBR-1 skip-on-complete guard for iter 1; when `--from-stage <cycle>` targets a cycle whose members already have `stage_statuses = \"complete\"` from prior iterations, all members are silently skipped in iter 1, no `stage.start` is emitted for any cycle member, and the cycle re-converges with zero actual dispatches — violating DSFSTG-1.",
      "quote": "if [[ \"${_ZBUILD_FROM_STAGE_EMIT_START:-false}\" == \"true\" ]]; then\n        _is_resume=true\n        export _ZBUILD_FROM_STAGE_EMIT_START=false\n    fi",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "high",
      "line": 1473,
      "message": "The DSCMBR-1 skip guard reads the flat `stage_statuses[$s]` map, which never resets between iterations; when the run is interrupted in the window after `_cycle_state_write_iter_start` writes `current_iter=N` but before any member of iter N has dispatched, all members show `\"complete\"` from iter N-1 — the skip guard fires for every member of iter N, leaving the entire iteration with zero dispatches and no `stage.start` events.",
      "quote": "if [[ \"$_resume_first_iter\" == \"true\" ]]; then\n            local _cmbr_status\n            _cmbr_status=\"$(jq -r --arg s \"$s\" '.stage_statuses[$s] // \"pending\"' \\\n                \"$state_file\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"pending\")\"\n            if [[ \"$_cmbr_status\" == \"complete\" ]]; then",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    }
  ]
}
